notes: Trigger and workflow cases for html2figma. Run each 3x in a fresh session; a case passes when the skill triggers (or stays quiet) as marked, and the first response matches the expected first step.

cases.name: zh-html-to-figma-sticky
cases.prompt: 把这个 HTML 手机原型转成 Figma 可编辑原型，底部导航要固定在屏幕底部，能点击跳屏。
cases.expected_first_step: Phase 1 preflight: inventory screens, sizes, hotspots, persistent layers (do not import yet).

cases.name: en-html-mockup-import
cases.prompt: I have a local HTML mockup of a mobile app. Import it into Figma as editable layers and keep the bottom tab bar fixed while scrolling.
cases.expected_first_step: Phase 1 preflight; confirm viewport size and persistent layers before import.

cases.name: zh-repair-dock-scroll
cases.prompt: Figma 里底部栏跑到长图最下面了，而且页面不能滚动，帮我修一下。
cases.expected_first_step: Diagnose viewport/UNCLIP and overflowDirection; then reshape to 3xx×8xx viewport.

cases.name: zh-no-html-author-first
cases.prompt: 我还没有原型，先帮我做一版手机 App 的 HTML 原型，确认后再进 Figma。
cases.expected_first_step: Phase 0: author HTML to references/html-prototype-spec.md, render screenshots, stop for user sign-off.

cases.name: negative-native-figma-wiring
cases.prompt: 帮我把这个 Figma 原型里的按钮都连起来，做成点击跳屏的演示，我没有 HTML 稿。
cases.expected_first_step: Answer as native Figma prototype wiring; do not run the HTML import pipeline.

cases.name: negative-desktop-static-import
cases.prompt: 把这个 HTML 页面做成 Figma 设计稿，桌面端 1440 宽，不需要点击交互。
cases.expected_first_step: Treat as a desktop static import; the skill's 393×852 clickable-prototype pipeline does not apply.

cases.name: negative-simple-howto
cases.prompt: Figma 的 iPhone 15 Pro 设备模型在哪里设置？
cases.expected_first_step: Answer the UI question directly (Prototype panel, no selection → Device).

cases.name: en-repair-sticky-header
cases.prompt: After importing my HTML prototype, the sticky header scrolls away in Figma Present. Make it stay fixed.
cases.expected_first_step: Check persistent-layer classification and numberOfFixedChildren ordering; verify with Present scroll.

cases.name: zh-responsive-vh-import
cases.prompt: 我的 HTML 原型用了 100vh 和 max-width 媒体查询，导入 Figma 后布局全乱了，怎么办？
cases.expected_first_step: Set the importer viewport to the prototype size before Convert; rebuild feed if needed.

cases.name: negative-plugin-install
cases.prompt: open-htmltofigma 这个插件怎么安装？
cases.expected_first_step: Answer the installation question from the README; do not start the full pipeline.
